name: What is the process for installing under-cabinet task lighting?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for installing under-cabinet task lighting?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process typically begins with an initial consultation to discuss your needs and preferences, followed by an on-site assessment and a detailed quote. Once approved, our team prepares the area, ensuring power is safely disconnected. For hardwired systems, this involves running new electrical lines through walls or cabinets to the fixture locations. Fixtures are then mounted, wiring is connected, and the system is tested. Finally, any necessary repairs to drywall or paint are completed, leaving your kitchen clean and functional. The exact steps may vary based on your chosen lighting type.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, on-site assessment, quote, preparing the area, running electrical lines, mounting fixtures, wiring, testing, and final cleanup.
